May 11

23 O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps. (Jeremiah 10:23 KJV)

God did not intend for man to direct his own steps. When we quit letting the Lord lead us, we become no better than animals that do not have the God given spirit in them. We can never reach our potential that God has for us, unless we learn to let Him lead us in all things throughout our lives. This same point was made by Solomon in Proverbs (Proverbs 20:24).

If we will let God direct our paths and not lean on our own understanding, then we will be able to enjoy the life that our Father wants for us (Proverbs 3:5-6). Why is it that we humans are so self-centered that we have to do things our own way, and be our own gods, when we have a God that wants to help us in all things? The smarter we think we are, the dumber we act. This generation is so full of pride and arrogance that few truly give themselves to God, and let Him direct their paths. We must first be born again (Romans 10:9-10), then give ourselves to God (Romans 12:1), renew our minds with the word (Romans 12:2), and then work out our salvation (Philippians 2:12) by obeying Jesus (Hebrews 5:9) to insure our salvation. Please, Jesus, guide me in the paths you have for me, in all things.
